sloka: अथवा रामरूपेण कृतान्तः स्वयमागतः ।मायां तव विनाशाय विधायाप्रतितर्किताम् ।। ६.११४.१२ ।।
transliteration: athavā rāmarūpeṇa kṛtāntaḥ svayamāgataḥ ।māyāṁ tava vināśāya vidhāyāpratitarkitām ।। 6.114.12 ।।

translations.english: "Or else, the god of death would have come in the form of Rama for your destruction, having right knowledge and taking an inconceivable recourse.
